world_seed.visual_direction: top-down pixel art, storm-gray canvas, celadon instruments, electric-yellow kite silk, magenta warning thread, wet charcoal floors, silver condensation

premise: Beneath a planet-scale weather engine, vendors trade unfinished atmospheric phenomena that alter local visibility and safety.
simulation_objective: Simulate the social and physical impact of localized weather deployment on trade routes and bargaining leverage.
economy_focus: Tradeable weather lots, delivery dispute resolution, and climate-altering commodities.
exploration_focus: Navigating six interconnected market rooms with shifting visibility and environmental hazards.
visual_style: Storm-gray and wet charcoal palette with celadon and electric-yellow accents; no text or logos.

visual_consistency_rules: All sprites must have a 1px selective dark-gray outline.
No faces or skin visible; use hoods, masks, or high collars.
Materials must appear 'wet' using high-contrast yellow highlights.
Maintain a compact 1:1.5 body-to-head ratio for 32x32 grid.
Color-coding: Yellow for power, Celadon for trade, Gray for utility.

visual_canon.lighting: High-contrast, flickering industrial lamps with localized volumetric fog shadows
